simple.meaning: to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רָקַע (H7554) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רָקַע (râqaʻ) means to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 22 43.

definitions.short: to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal)
definitions.usage: beat, make broad, spread abroad (forth, over, out, into plates), stamp, stretch.
definitions.full: H7554. raqa [ רָקַע ] verb beat, stamp, beat out, spread out (Late Hebrew id. ; Hiph`il, Aramaic רְקַע Aph`el, both spread out , and derivatives; Syriac press down ( Luke 6:38 ᵑ6 ), spread out , also consolidate ; Arabic patch, put on a patch, repair , compare Christian-Palestinian Aramaic patch , swaddling-bands , Schw Idioticon 90 ; Phoenician מרקע platter , or bowl , of gold CIS i. 90, 1 ); — Qal Imperfect 1singular suffix אֶרְקָעֵם 2Sam 22:43 I will stamp them down (probably gloss to אֲדִקֵּם preceding, of. Bae Psa 18:43 ); Imperative בְּדַגְלְךָ רְקַע Ezek 6:11 beat (stamp) with thy foot, in token of contemptuous pleasure, compare Da (|| בְכַמְּךָ הַכֵּה ); so Infinitive construct suffix בְּרָ֑גֶל רַקְעֲךָ 25:6 (|| יָד מַחְאֲךָ ); Participle active as substantive construct (Ges § 65d ) הָאָרֶץ רֹקַע (i.e. ׳י ) he that (beateth out) spreadeth out the earth Isa 42:5 , ׳הַא רֹקַע 44:24 , הָא ׳רוֺקַע Psa 136:6 . Pi`el Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יְרַקְּעֶנּוּ בַּזָּהָב Isa 40:19 a goldsmith with gold over-layeth it (literally beateth it out 3masculine plural הַזָּהָב מַּחֵי אֶתֿ וַיְרַקְּעוּ Exod 39:3 they beat out the plates of gold ; suffix צִמּוּי וַיְרִקְּעוּם Num 17:4 they beat them out as plating. Pu`al Participle מְרֻקָּ֑ע כֶּסֶף Jer 10:9 silver beaten out. Hiph`il Imperfect 2masculine singular לִשְׁחָקִים עִמּוֺ תַּרְקִיעַ Job 37:18 canst thou make with (= like) him a spreading for clouds (spread out clouds; cf, רָקִיעַ )?
